limits: Five directly checked source representations, including an official UK treaty reproduction of C190; selected excerpts, not a full political, legal or media corpus.
Source verification by an automated research agent is distinct from human review; no human approval is asserted.
Default lens queries exclude candidates and analyst drafts. Source assertions may be normative or indirectly attributed; source_verified does not certify real-world truth.
Published-by filters source publication dates only, not a historical knowledge snapshot, legal validity or present applicability.
No live D1 connection, automatic legal conclusion, motive diagnosis, outlet-wide bias score, full conflict ontology or measured model-quality gain is implemented.
packet.policy: Checked source wording only; no human approval is inferred. Records retain unknown validity and applicability. Omitted context may change interpretation.
